name: Islamabad Marriott Hotel
assumptions: Height 21.9 m at the hood tips comes from the photos (four window rows, a ground storey, a loggia floor, bay width as the scale); no published figure exists and the dossier estimate was 19 m.
Sources say five storeys; photos show a ground storey plus four window rows plus the loggia floor. The photos were followed.
Bay width 4.6 m is derived from fitting 14 bays, a core and 18 bays into the OSM long side; the slab is taken to fill that side.
Slab depth 19 m is estimated from one oblique aerial photo and a double-loaded room plan.
The slab is placed along the rear edge of the OSM outline, with the low front blocks filling the rest towards the road.
Low front blocks, hall roofs, pavilion count and the entrance position are placed by eye from three photos taken from different points; plan sizes are estimates.
The rear facade is modelled from one courtyard photo showing alternating window rows; the rear ground floor terrace and rear low wing are left out.
Pavilion roofs are red as in the 2017 and dusk photos; one aerial shows them pale, possibly covered.
The 4 m perimeter wall is left out: its route is unknown, and recent front photos show a hedge at the road, modelled here at an estimated 2.6 m.
The roof sign is drawn as plain red blocks, sized from the photos, and tops out at about 24.6 m; letterforms are not reproduced.
Rooftop plant blocks are simple boxes; their sizes are guesses.
Colours are estimated from photos under overcast and dusk light; night glow values are estimates.
